about: Varrock, the Misthalin roadmap's Varrock piece. Step 2: the bankers of the West Bank (six, the Wiki's count: five behind its booths at x 3186 and one behind its locked door) and the East Bank (six, behind its booths at z 3419), on mejrs's tiles, standing still; the two at the Deadman booths are multi-NPCs that show the ordinary banker. Step 1: the city's townsfolk. Guards (Guard (Varrock) on the Wiki, 37 of them: 13 in the city, 2 on the walls, 22 in the palace) as the six fai_varrock_guard02 variants and the captain's look (fai_varrock_guard_captain02) that replaced fai_varrock_guard and its captain on 9 November 2022 (Wiki); men, women, imps, rats and the five stray dogs (three grey, two brown, Wiki). Tiles are where mejrs's list (github.com/mejrs/data_osrs NPCList_OSRS.json, recorded on live before November 2022) saw each one; a wanderer's spawn tile is only near where it was seen, and every wander range is guessed (3 for guards, 5 for the rest).
